# AeroLog for AI Coding Agents

> AeroLog is an ultra-fast, local-first, multi-model storage engine engineered in pure Rust. It features an append-only Bitcask log, monotonic Hybrid Logical Clocks (HLC), hardware-accelerated CRC32 checksums, memory-bounded dual-tier indexing (< 15 MB RSS), and Mozilla UniFFI cross-platform bindings for Kotlin and Swift.

## System Invariants & Rules for Code Generation

When generating code using or contributing to AeroLog, AI agents (Cursor, Copilot, Antigravity, Claude, ChatGPT) MUST enforce the following rules:

1. **Zero-Emoji Policy**: Never generate emoji characters in code, docstrings, comments, commit messages, or markdown documentation.
2. **Sequential Append-Only I/O**: Writes strictly append to active segment files. Never perform in-place disk overwrites.
3. **No Unwraps in Core Logic**: Never use `unwrap()` or `expect()` in production engine code. All errors must map into `Result<T, AeroLogError>`.
4. **Dual-Tier Memory Partitioning**: Point key-value entities live in `KeyDir`; append-only streams must use `SparseStreamIndex` to keep RAM bounded under 15 MB.
5. **Monotonic Causality**: Every record header carries an HLC tuple `(physical_time, logical_counter, node_id_hash)` for deterministic Last-Write-Wins (LWW) conflict resolution without NTP.
6. **Defensive Validation**: Validate buffer boundaries and CRC32 checksums before deserialization to isolate corrupted trailing fragments from power cuts.
